pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with high edge angularity and serrated, star-like projections. Dark pigmented regions show sharp pixel-level transitions into the surrounding light corridors.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored negative space. Junction nodes are clearly defined at the intersections of three or more paths. Corridor thickness is non-uniform, tapering at vertex bottlenecks.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the margin of the neck and shoulder.
